author: andrewgcodes
name: Combined Optimal: 10L seq4096 + val-only + sliding window + tuned Muon + int6
blurb: 10-layer transformer with seq_len=4096, MLP_HIDDEN=960, val-only training (organizer-approved), sliding window eval (stride=64), tuned Muon optimizer (momentum=0.99, warmup from 0.92 over 1500 steps), int6 compression for layers 3-7, and lower learning rates.
